description: WSO2 SAP S/4HANA Characteristic Attribute Catalog provides a way to interact with the [Characteristic Attribute Catalog - Read API](https://api.sap.com/api/API_CHARCATTRIBUTECATALOG_SRV/overview). The service allows to read the plant-specific selected sets of a characteristic attribute catalog, with their codes and texts, that are used to record inspection results for qualitative characteristics, for example, the codes 01 (Smooth) and 02 (Rough) for the characteristic Surface.
key-features: Read the selected sets of a characteristic attribute catalog for a plant
Read the codes in a selected set with their valuation and defect class
Read the language-dependent texts of selected sets and codes
